definition: I. דִּישֹׁן noun [masculine] a clean animal , ᵐ5 πύγαργος compare ᵑ9 ; hence AV RV & most pygarg , a kind of antelope or gazelle , compare Di Lev 11:2 f.; perhaps rather mountain-goat, Hom NS 391 compare Ethiopic version [ ᵑ8̈ ]; only Deut 14:5 — ( Hom l.c. derives from √ דושׁ with kindred meaning of spring, leap & compare Assyrian daššu ; so already Dl S i. 54 ).
